scenes.caption: FITFLOW AI: a business OS for fitness coaches (interactive prototype)
scenes.text: This is FITFLOW AI: an interactive product prototype of a business operating system for independent fitness coaches who sell their coaching online.

scenes.caption: Light and dark themes, switched instantly
scenes.text: Every screen comes in light and dark mode, and the switch is instant.

scenes.caption: Scroll-driven “How it works” (GSAP ScrollTrigger)
scenes.text: As you scroll, the How it works section pins in place and steps through the coach's journey: attract, capture, follow up, and convert.

scenes.caption: The live demo: KPIs, trends and AI insights from sample data
scenes.text: Here's the live demo. The overview pulls key numbers, trends and AI insights from one sample dataset, so every figure on every screen agrees.

scenes.caption: Lead pipeline: every enquiry has a source, stage and follow-up date
scenes.text: Every enquiry lands in a pipeline, with its source, stage, value and next follow-up date. Opening a lead shows its details and full history.

scenes.caption: AI drafts the follow-up. The coach edits it and sends it themselves.
scenes.text: For follow-ups, the AI drafts a personal message from the lead's goal and stage. The coach edits it and sends it themselves. Nothing is ever sent automatically.

scenes.caption: AI Offer Builder: five guided steps to an editable, claims-checked offer
scenes.text: The offer builder walks the coach through a few quick choices: the goal, the audience, the format, and a price, with guidance on what's typical. Then it drafts a complete offer, with a title, what's included and who it's for, and checks it for risky health claims. Everything stays editable.

scenes.caption: Storefront builder with live desktop and phone previews
scenes.text: The storefront builder restyles the coach's public page, with live desktop and phone previews.

scenes.caption: The coach's public page: enquiries land straight in the pipeline
scenes.text: This is the page followers actually see. When someone sends an enquiry here, it shows up in the pipeline as a new lead.

scenes.caption: Assistant answers questions from the same data as the charts
scenes.text: The assistant answers business questions using the same numbers as the charts, like which lead source is converting best.

scenes.caption: Every screen works in both themes
scenes.text: And all of it works in dark mode too.

scenes.caption: Case study, Figma file and code: links in the description
scenes.text: The case study covers the problem, the design decisions and the Figma design system. The live demo, the Figma file and the code are all linked in the description.
